items.prompt: Say it with 不但…，還….
items.sub: 搭太魯閣號去花蓮。票很便宜，最棒的是坐起來很快。

sentence.traditional: 搭太魯閣號去花蓮，不但便宜，還很快。
sentence.simplified: 搭太鲁阁号去花莲，不但便宜，还很快。
sentence.pinyin: Dā Tàilǔgé Hào qù Huālián, búdàn piányi, hái hěn kuài.
sentence.english: Take the Taroko Express to Hualien. It is not only cheap but also fast.

repairs.note: 可是 marks a contrast; both points here are good things, so add the second with 還.
The ticket is cheap, not expensive; 很貴 contradicts the context.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 不但 + 便宜 + 還 + 很快.
items.successNote: 不但 introduces the first good point; 還 adds the second.

items.prompt: Say it with 不但…，還….
items.sub: 去國外念書，可以學好英文，最棒的是可以認識很多新朋友。

sentence.traditional: 去國外念書，不但學好英文，還認識很多新朋友。
sentence.simplified: 去国外念书，不但学好英文，还认识很多新朋友。
sentence.pinyin: Qù guówài niànshū, búdàn xué hǎo Yīngwén, hái rènshi hěn duō xīn péngyou.
sentence.english: Study abroad: you not only learn English well but also meet many new friends.

repairs.note: 但是 marks a contrast; both results are good, so add the second with 還.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 不但 + 學好英文 + 還 + 認識 + 很多新朋友.
items.successNote: The subject stays the same; 還 adds the second benefit.

items.prompt: Say it with 不但…，還….
items.sub: 台灣的 KTV 很好玩，最棒的是很便宜。

sentence.traditional: 台灣的 KTV 不但好玩，還很便宜呢！
sentence.simplified: 台湾的 KTV 不但好玩，还很便宜呢！
sentence.pinyin: Táiwān de KTV búdàn hǎowán, hái hěn piányi ne!
sentence.english: Taiwan's KTVs are not only fun but also very cheap!

repairs.note: 但是 marks a contrast; both points are good things.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 不但 + 好玩 + 還 + 很便宜 + 呢.

items.prompt: Say it with 不但…，還….
items.sub: 這家民宿有游泳池，也有免費的無線網路。

repairs.note: 還 opens the second point, after the comma.
不但 must open the first point, before 有游泳池.
但是 marks a contrast; both points are good things.
但是 marks a contrast; both points are good things.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 不但 before 有游泳池 and 還 before 有免費的無線網路.

result.traditional: 這家民宿不但有游泳池，還有免費的無線網路。
result.simplified: 这家民宿不但有游泳池，还有免费的无线网路。
result.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù búdàn yǒu yóuyǒngchí, hái yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù.
result.english: This B&B not only has a swimming pool but also free Wi-Fi.

items.successNote: 不但 sits before the first point; 還 sits before the second.

items.prompt: The B&B owner treated him to a meal and gave him local specialties. Say it with 不但…，還….

promptZh.traditional: 民宿老闆請他吃飯，也送他名產。用「不但……，還……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 民宿老板请他吃饭，也送他名产。用「不但……，还……」说。

items.sub: 他去花蓮住民宿，老闆請他吃飯，最讓他開心的是送他名產。

sentence.traditional: 他不但請我吃飯，還送我名產。
sentence.simplified: 他不但请我吃饭，还送我名产。
sentence.pinyin: Tā búdàn qǐng wǒ chīfàn, hái sòng wǒ míngchǎn.
sentence.english: He not only treated me to a meal but also gave me local specialties.

repairs.note: 可是 marks a contrast; the two gifts are both additions.
所以 marks a result; 還 adds the second gift.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 不但 + 請我吃飯 + 還 + 送我名產.

B2L07-G02-P166.title: Practice: 一 + M（+N）+ 都／也 + Neg（+Vaux）+ V

items.prompt: Say it with 一…也….
items.sub: 那家餐廳客滿了，沒有位子。

result.traditional: 那家餐廳客滿了，一個位子也沒有。
result.simplified: 那家餐厅客满了，一个位子也没有。
result.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng kèmǎn le, yí ge wèizi yě méiyǒu.
result.english: The restaurant is full; there isn't even one seat.

repairs.note: The measure word 個 is missing; say 一個位子.
都有 is positive; the restaurant is full and has no seats.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一個位子 + 也沒有.
items.successNote: 一 + measure word + noun, then 也 + negative: not even one.

items.prompt: Say it with 一…都….
items.sub: 這裡沒有便利商店，很不方便。

sentence.traditional: 住在這裡真不方便，一家便利商店都沒有。
sentence.simplified: 住在这里真不方便，一家便利商店都没有。
sentence.pinyin: Zhù zài zhèlǐ zhēn bù fāngbiàn, yì jiā biànlì shāngdiàn dōu méiyǒu.
sentence.english: It's really inconvenient living here; there isn't even one convenience store.

sentence.traditional: 住在這裡真不方便，便利商店一家都沒有。
sentence.simplified: 住在这里真不方便，便利商店一家都没有。
sentence.pinyin: Zhù zài zhèlǐ zhēn bù fāngbiàn, biànlì shāngdiàn yì jiā dōu méiyǒu.
sentence.english: It's really inconvenient living here; there isn't even one convenience store.

repairs.note: 便利商店 takes the measure word 家, not 個.
The context says there is none; use 沒有.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一家 + 便利商店 + 都 + 沒有.

items.prompt: You cannot sing. Say it with 一…都….

promptZh.traditional: 你不會唱歌。用「一……都……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你不会唱歌。用「一……都……」说。

items.sub: 朋友問你為什麼跟我們來 KTV。你不會唱歌。

sentence.traditional: 你一首歌都不會唱，為什麼要跟我們來 KTV 呢？
sentence.simplified: 你一首歌都不会唱，为什么要跟我们来 KTV 呢？
sentence.pinyin: Nǐ yì shǒu gē dōu bú huì chàng, wèishénme yào gēn wǒmen lái KTV ne?
sentence.english: You can't even sing one song—why did you come to KTV with us?

repairs.note: 會唱 is positive; the context says you cannot sing.
With 都, the object comes before it: 一首歌都…
都 needs the negative 不會 before the verb here.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一首歌 + 都 + 不會唱.

items.prompt: Say it with 一…也….
items.sub: 那棟公寓的房租很便宜，可是裡面沒有家具，也沒有床。

segments.traditional: 那棟公寓的房租很便宜，可是裡面沒有家具，
segments.simplified: 那栋公寓的房租很便宜，可是里面没有家具，

result.traditional: 那棟公寓的房租很便宜，可是裡面沒有家具，一張床也沒有。
result.simplified: 那栋公寓的房租很便宜，可是里面没有家具，一张床也没有。
result.pinyin: Nà dòng gōngyù de fángzū hěn piányi, kěshì lǐmiàn méiyǒu jiājù, yì zhāng chuáng yě méiyǒu.
result.english: The rent for that apartment is cheap, but there's no furniture inside—not even a bed.

repairs.note: 床 takes the measure word 張, not 個.
都有 is positive; the apartment has no furniture.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一張床 + 也沒有.

items.prompt: You went to the bookstore yesterday but did not buy a book. Say it with 一…也….

promptZh.traditional: 你昨天去書店，可是沒有買書。用「一……也……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你昨天去书店，可是没有买书。用「一……也……」说。

sentence.traditional: 我昨天去書店，一本書也沒買。
sentence.simplified: 我昨天去书店，一本书也没买。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān qù shūdiàn, yì běn shū yě méi mǎi.
sentence.english: I went to the bookstore yesterday and didn't buy even one book.

repairs.note: 買了 is positive; the context says you bought nothing.
書 takes the measure word 本: 一本書.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一本書 + 也 + 沒買.

items.prompt: He went traveling but forgot to bring clothes. Say it with 一…都….

promptZh.traditional: 他去旅行，可是忘了帶衣服。用「一……都……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他去旅行，可是忘了带衣服。用「一……都……」说。

sentence.traditional: 他去旅行，一件衣服都沒帶。
sentence.simplified: 他去旅行，一件衣服都没带。
sentence.pinyin: Tā qù lǚxíng, yí jiàn yīfu dōu méi dài.
sentence.english: He went traveling and didn't bring even one piece of clothing.

repairs.note: 帶了 is positive; the context says he forgot to bring clothes.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一件衣服 + 都 + 沒帶.

items.prompt: He just moved to Taipei and has no computer yet. Say it with 一…都….

promptZh.traditional: 他剛搬到台北，還沒有電腦。用「一……都……」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他刚搬到台北，还没有电脑。用「一……都……」说。

sentence.traditional: 他剛搬到台北，一台電腦都沒有。
sentence.simplified: 他刚搬到台北，一台电脑都没有。
sentence.pinyin: Tā gāng bān dào Táiběi, yì tái diànnǎo dōu méiyǒu.
sentence.english: He just moved to Taipei and doesn't have even one computer.

repairs.note: The context says he has no computer yet; use 沒有.
電腦 takes the measure word 台, not 個.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一台電腦 + 都 + 沒有.
items.sub: 他剛搬到台北，還沒有電腦。

items.prompt: The money is used up. Say it with 讓.

promptZh.traditional: 錢用完了。用「讓」說。
promptZh.simplified: 钱用完了。用「让」说。

items.sub: 這個月我買了不少書，錢都用完了。房東說：沒辦法，你讓朋友幫你，這樣就可以付了。

sentence.traditional: 這個月我買了不少書，錢都用完了，可以讓我下個月再付房租？
sentence.simplified: 这个月我买了不少书，钱都用完了，可以让我下个月再付房租？
sentence.pinyin: Zhège yuè wǒ mǎi le bùshǎo shū, qián dōu yòng wán le, kěyǐ ràng wǒ xià ge yuè zài fù fángzū?
sentence.english: I bought quite a few books this month and used up all my money. Can you let me pay the rent next month?

repairs.note: 可是 marks a contrast; you are making a polite request here.
The money for this month is already gone; you are asking about next month.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 可以讓我 + 下個月 + 再付 + 房租.

items.prompt: They have only known each other for three days. Say it with 讓.

promptZh.traditional: 他們才認識三天。用「讓」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他们才认识三天。用「让」说。

items.sub: 先生約小姐週末去阿里山露營。他們才認識三天。

sentence.traditional: 我們才認識三天，讓我再想想，再告訴你。
sentence.simplified: 我们才认识三天，让我再想想，再告诉你。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒmen cái rènshi sān tiān, ràng wǒ zài xiǎngxiang, zài gàosu nǐ.
sentence.english: We've only known each other for three days. Let me think about it and tell you later.

repairs.note: 告訴我 means tell me; she is the one who will tell him later.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 讓 + 我 + 再想想 + 再 + 告訴你.

items.prompt: The son is already twenty. Say it with 讓.

promptZh.traditional: 兒子已經二十歲了。用「讓」說。
promptZh.simplified: 儿子已经二十岁了。用「让」说。

items.sub: 爸爸希望兒子大學畢業以後出國留學。兒子已經二十歲了。

sentence.traditional: 我已經二十歲了，要不要出國留學，讓我自己決定。
sentence.simplified: 我已经二十岁了，要不要出国留学，让我自己决定。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng èrshí suì le, yào bu yào chūguó liúxué, ràng wǒ zìjǐ juédìng.
sentence.english: I'm already twenty. Whether to study abroad—let me decide for myself.

sentence.traditional: 我已經二十歲了，要不要出國留學，讓我決定。
sentence.simplified: 我已经二十岁了，要不要出国留学，让我决定。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng èrshí suì le, yào bu yào chūguó liúxué, ràng wǒ juédìng.
sentence.english: I'm already twenty. Whether to study abroad—let me decide.

repairs.note: 告訴 means tell; the son is asking to decide himself.
爸爸 is the person he is speaking to, not the one who decides.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 讓 + 我 + 自己 + 決定.

items.prompt: The patient wants to go home. Say it with 讓.

promptZh.traditional: 病人想回家。用「讓」說。
promptZh.simplified: 病人想回家。用「让」说。

items.sub: 病人說他的頭不疼了，想回家。

sentence.traditional: 等你把這個藥吃了，就讓你回家。
sentence.simplified: 等你把这个药吃了，就让你回家。
sentence.pinyin: Děng nǐ bǎ zhège yào chī le, jiù ràng nǐ huí jiā.
sentence.english: After you take this medicine, I'll let you go home.

repairs.note: 再 would mean 'go home again'; this is the first time he is allowed to go.
吃 is already in the first clause; the answer says what happens after that.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 就 + 讓 + 你 + 回家.

items.prompt: Your friend is carrying a lot of things and you want to help. Say it with 讓.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友拿了很多東西，你想幫他。用「讓」說。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友拿了很多东西，你想帮他。用「让」说。

sentence.traditional: 請讓我幫你。
sentence.simplified: 请让我帮你。
sentence.pinyin: Qǐng ràng wǒ bāng nǐ.
sentence.english: Please let me help you.

sentence.traditional: 讓我幫你。
sentence.simplified: 让我帮你。
sentence.pinyin: Ràng wǒ bāng nǐ.
sentence.english: Let me help you.

repairs.note: 幫我 means help me; you are offering to help your friend.
The person who helps comes after 讓: 讓我幫你.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 請 + 讓 + 我 + 幫你.

items.prompt: Your parents worry about you and do not want you to travel alone. Say it with 讓.

promptZh.traditional: 父母擔心你，不希望你一個人去旅行。用「讓」說。
promptZh.simplified: 父母担心你，不希望你一个人去旅行。用「让」说。

sentence.traditional: 父母不讓我一個人去旅行。
sentence.simplified: 父母不让我一个人去旅行。
sentence.pinyin: Fùmǔ bú ràng wǒ yí ge rén qù lǚxíng.
sentence.english: My parents won't let me travel alone.

repairs.note: The context says they worry; they do not allow it, so use 不讓.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 父母 + 不讓 + 我 + 一個人 + 去旅行.

items.prompt: What does 讓 mean here?

promptZh.traditional: 這個「讓」是什麼意思？
promptZh.simplified: 这个「让」是什么意思？

sentence.traditional: 那件事讓我很傷心。
sentence.simplified: 那件事让我很伤心。
sentence.pinyin: Nà jiàn shì ràng wǒ hěn shāngxīn.
sentence.english: That matter made me very sad.

cards.note: 讓 + person + feeling: the matter caused the sadness.

sentence.traditional: 媽媽不讓我出去玩。
sentence.simplified: 妈妈不让我出去玩。
sentence.pinyin: Māma bú ràng wǒ chūqù wán.
sentence.english: Mom won't let me go out and play.

cards.note: 不讓 means does not allow; this is about permission.

sentence.traditional: 這本書讓我想睡覺。
sentence.simplified: 这本书让我想睡觉。
sentence.pinyin: Zhè běn shū ràng wǒ xiǎng shuìjiào.
sentence.english: This book makes me want to sleep.

cards.note: 讓 + person + feeling/state: the book makes me sleepy.

sentence.traditional: 爸爸不讓我喝酒。
sentence.simplified: 爸爸不让我喝酒。
sentence.pinyin: Bàba bú ràng wǒ hē jiǔ.
sentence.english: Dad won't let me drink alcohol.

cards.note: 不讓 means does not allow; this is about permission.

items.successNote: 讓 + a feeling means 'make'; 讓 + someone do something often means 'let or allow'.

items.prompt: You worked all day. Say it with 是.

promptZh.traditional: 你忙了一天。用「是」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你忙了一天。用「是」说。

items.sub: 你忙了一天。朋友問你累了吧。

sentence.traditional: 我是很累，所以現在要回家了。
sentence.simplified: 我是很累，所以现在要回家了。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ shì hěn lèi, suǒyǐ xiànzài yào huí jiā le.
sentence.english: I am indeed very tired, so I'm going home now.

repairs.note: 累 alone states the fact; 是 adds confirmation, which the question asks for.
The context says you worked all day; 不累 contradicts that.
嗎 makes a question; the speaker is confirming that he is tired.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我 + 是 + 很累.
items.successNote: 是 before the state verb confirms it, like 'indeed'.

items.prompt: A friend says Chinese is important. Say it with 是.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友說中文很重要。用「是」說。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友说中文很重要。用「是」说。

items.sub: 朋友說中文很重要，把中文學好了，比較容易找工作。

sentence.traditional: 是真的，想到中國去工作的外國人一定得學。
sentence.simplified: 是真的，想到中国去工作的外国人一定得学。
sentence.pinyin: Shì zhēn de, xiǎngdào Zhōngguó qù gōngzuò de wàiguó rén yídìng děi xué.
sentence.english: It's true. Foreigners who want to work in China definitely have to learn it.

repairs.note: 真 needs 是 to confirm the statement: 是真的.
不是 denies it; here you agree.
嗎 makes a question; you are confirming.
很 needs an adjective after it; 是真的 confirms the statement.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 是 + 真的.

items.prompt: This new phone is expensive. Say it with 是.

promptZh.traditional: 這支新手機很貴。用「是」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这支新手机很贵。用「是」说。

items.sub: 朋友說這支新手機五萬塊，太貴了。

sentence.traditional: 是有點兒貴，可是這個牌子很有名，我一定要買。
sentence.simplified: 是有点儿贵，可是这个牌子很有名，我一定要买。
sentence.pinyin: Shì yǒudiǎnr guì, kěshì zhège páizi hěn yǒumíng, wǒ yídìng yào mǎi.
sentence.english: It is a bit expensive, but this brand is famous; I definitely want to buy it.

repairs.note: 不貴 contradicts 太貴了吧 and the speaker's 可是.
便宜 contradicts the five-thousand-dollar price.
嗎 makes a question; the speaker is admitting a fact.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 是 + 有點兒 + 貴.

items.prompt: This B&B is clean. Say it with 是.

promptZh.traditional: 這家民宿很乾淨。用「是」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这家民宿很干净。用「是」说。

sentence.traditional: 這家民宿是真的乾淨。
sentence.simplified: 这家民宿是真的干净。
sentence.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù shì zhēn de gānjìng.
sentence.english: This B&B really is clean.

repairs.note: 不乾淨 is the opposite; the context says it is clean.
嗎 makes a question; this is a confirmation.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 這家民宿 + 是 + 真的 + 乾淨.
items.sub: 這家民宿很乾淨。

items.prompt: Meixin says the Suhua Highway is more dangerous. Say it with 是.

promptZh.traditional: 美心說蘇花公路比較危險。用「是」說。
promptZh.simplified: 美心说苏花公路比较危险。用「是」说。

items.sub: 美心說蘇花公路比較危險，搭火車比較安全。

sentence.traditional: 蘇花公路是比較危險，搭火車比較安全。
sentence.simplified: 苏花公路是比较危险，搭火车比较安全。
sentence.pinyin: Sūhuā Gōnglù shì bǐjiào wēixiǎn, dā huǒchē bǐjiào ānquán.
sentence.english: The Suhua Highway is indeed more dangerous; taking the train is safer.

repairs.note: The highway is the dangerous one; 安全 describes the train.
嗎 makes a question; the speaker is confirming the danger.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 蘇花公路 + 是 + 比較 + 危險.

items.prompt: The free maps at the MRT station are gone. Say it with 光.

promptZh.traditional: 捷運站的免費地圖沒有了。用「光」說。
promptZh.simplified: 捷运站的免费地图没有了。用「光」说。

items.sub: 這個捷運站有免費的地圖。可是地圖已經沒有了。

sentence.traditional: 這個捷運站有免費的地圖，可是已經被拿光了。
sentence.simplified: 这个捷运站有免费的地图，可是已经被拿光了。

items.prompt: Mrs. Chen is not worried about her son. Say it with 一點兒…都….

sentence.traditional: 我一點兒都不擔心，他會自己做飯、打掃。

repairs.note: 很擔心 is positive; she says she is not worried.
擔心 alone has no negative; the point needs 一點兒都不 + 擔心.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一點兒 + 都 + 不 + 擔心.
